systems.name: OrganizationPage
systems.function: The Spartan Laboratories website: a Kotlin multi-module build whose shared models and copy feed a Compose HTML frontend and a Ktor server, and the deployment system that moves it to the live host.

systems.name: shared
systems.function: Data models, API routes, JSON configuration and the site copy, the single contract between the backend and the frontend.

systems.name: server
systems.function: Ktor backend on Netty: the JSON API under /api and the compiled frontend with its API reference, packaged as one runnable jar.

systems.name: web
systems.function: Compose HTML frontend in Kotlin/JS: builds to a static site that renders its bundled copy and, when the Ktor server hosts it, the live copy from the API, and carries the generated API reference at docs/api/.

systems.name: deployment
systems.function: Moves repository content to the live host on two paths: the site through staging and a person's approval to production, and docs/ straight to the documents folder; the test-only workflow-checks module holds its workflows' regression tests.
